title: Glowing helicopter
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- main rotor blur / disc -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='22' rx='42' ry='5' fill='#55e0ff' opacity='0.45'/>
  <!-- rotor blades -->
  <rect x='8' y='19' width='84' height='4' rx='2' fill='#7ef7ff'/>
  <!-- rotor hub -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='22' r='5' fill='#33c8e8'/>
  <!-- rotor mast -->
  <rect x='47' y='26' width='6' height='8' rx='2' fill='#66e6ff'/>
  <!-- tail boom -->
  <rect x='58' y='45' width='28' height='7' rx='3' fill='#3ad7ff'/>
  <!-- tail rotor -->
  <circle cx='86' cy='48' r='7' fill='#7ef7ff' opacity='0.5'/>
  <circle cx='86' cy='48' r='3.5' fill='#33c8e8'/>
  <!-- tail fin -->
  <path d='M84 42 L92 34 L92 52 Z' fill='#2bb8e0'/>
  <!-- helicopter body -->
  <ellipse cx='44' cy='50' rx='24' ry='15' fill='#ffb347'/>
  <!-- body shading / belly -->
  <ellipse cx='44' cy='55' rx='20' ry='9' fill='#ffd27f'/>
  <!-- cockpit window -->
  <path d='M30 47 Q28 38 40 38 L46 38 Q52 38 50 47 Z' fill='#8ef4ff'/>
  <!-- cockpit glint -->
  <path d='M33 45 Q33 41 38 40' stroke='#d8ffff' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- door line -->
  <path d='M52 40 Q56 50 52 62' stroke='#e89a2e' stroke-width='2' fill='none'/>
  <!-- skids -->
  <rect x='26' y='68' width='36' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#ff9d2e'/>
  <rect x='32' y='61' width='3' height='8' fill='#e89a2e'/>
  <rect x='53' y='61' width='3' height='8' fill='#e89a2e'/>
  <!-- little light on tail -->
  <circle cx='86' cy='44' r='2' fill='#ff6688'/>
  <!-- cheerful cockpit highlight -->
  <circle cx='38' cy='46' r='2' fill='#33c8e8'/>
</svg>
